description: This file defines an Android activity demonstrating the use of SweepGradient in custom drawing with Canvas. It includes a main activity class 'Sweep' that hosts an inner 'SampleView' class performing animated drawing and handling key events.

classes.name: Sweep
classes.description: Main activity class extending GraphicsActivity, which sets the content view to an instance of the inner custom view class.

classes.name: SampleView
classes.description: Inner class extending View, responsible for custom drawing of animated sweep gradient effects and handling key events for toggling animation and dithering.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the content view to a new instance of SampleView.

methods.name: SampleView (constructor)
methods.description: Initializes the custom view, sets up Paint, creates a SweepGradient shader, and enables focus for key events.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Performs custom drawing: clears background, rotates the shader matrix, updates rotation angle, and draws circles; also handles timing for performance measurement.

methods.name: onKeyDown
methods.description: Handles key events 'D' to toggle dithering and 'T' to toggle timing visualization.
